title: Spec rubric missing no-signal-reoccurrence criterion for signal-lifecycle trait
description: Step 6 of moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path closes signal files in .moeb/signals/catalogue/, triggering the signal-lifecycle catalogue trait. The no-signal-reoccurrence criterion (Applies At: run) should appear in the ## Rubric / ### Structured table but was omitted from the initially written spec. The patch_file attempt to add it during Phase 4 review sub-loop was blocked by read-set enforcement. The entry remains absent from the spec's rubric.
proposed_resolution: The implementing run agent should read .moeb/specifications/moeb/moeb.deprecate-patch-file-as-default-write-path.md and add the no-signal-reoccurrence row to the ## Rubric / ### Structured table using write_file. Additionally, the spec.skill.md should be updated per this spec's Step 3 to use in-context application + write_file in the review sub-loop.
